description: This file defines the LeaveDuration class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin to represent the duration of a leave period. It includes constants, properties, and methods for setting and retrieving leave duration data, such as type, fromTime, and toTime. The class enforces validation rules to ensure correct leave duration configurations.

classes.name: LeaveDuration
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object representing the duration of a leave, including type and optional start/end times. It ensures correct configuration via validation and provides utility methods to check the duration type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LeaveDuration object with a specified type and optional fromTime and toTime.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the leave duration type as a string.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the leave duration type and validates it against predefined constants.

methods.name: getFromTime
methods.description: Returns the start DateTime of the leave period if the type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setFromTime
methods.description: Sets the start DateTime of the leave period, applicable for 'specify_time' type.

methods.name: getToTime
methods.description: Returns the end DateTime of the leave period if the type is 'specify_time'.

methods.name: setToTime
methods.description: Sets the end DateTime of the leave period, ensuring it is greater than fromTime.

methods.name: isTypeFullDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration type is full day.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDay
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration type is half day (morning or afternoon).

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayMorning
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration type is half day morning.

methods.name: isTypeHalfDayAfternoon
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration type is half day afternoon.

methods.name: isTypeSpecifyTime
methods.description: Checks if the leave duration type is specify time.
